purpose: Refactor overlay linking aviation flight-deck state and maritime vessel-state lanes without forcing one schema.
refactor_decision: Create a transport-state factor overlay rather than a new hard schema. This preserves domain-specific factors while exposing cross-domain state-legibility questions.
guardrail: Do not infer that aviation and maritime risks are the same. The overlay only says that state legibility, team coordination, correction rails, and survivability surfaces can be audited with comparable questions.
